title: Left Riemann sum for x² on [0, 2]

steps.say: Four rectangles of width 0.5 use the left endpoints 0, 0.5, 1 and 1.5; the first has height f(0) = 0.
Their heights are 0, 0.25, 1 and 2.25, so the area is about 0.5 × (0 + 0.25 + 1 + 2.25) = 1.75.
The exact area is 8/3 ≈ 2.667, so left endpoints underestimate this rising curve.
